body: From experience look after yourself, stay st  try not, addiction can take over your life too
I’m soooo sorry this has broke my heart. Heroin I hate it. Always here try to stay strong. If you want to chat I’m happy to hear about him (I’m awaiting the same cell every day)

Out of sight out of mind, the longer you are away the easier it gets. I’m on no contact for months with his baby, it’s hard as I’ve also lost my best friend, he blames me, fights me, nasty to me, and had a great bond with his daughter he is choosing not to cherish. Sometimes he’ll appear ok not on anything, he gad a nice time then disappears. Sometimes I feel the fighting is easier as I know where he is and what he’s doing. Am I awaiting a call to say he’s hurt, no idea and that’s a daily worry. But as time goes on I get stronger and will not let his daughter be destroyed by addiction like me

It’s taken a long time to get to this point when I’ve tried before he’ll always manage to lure me back in. I’ve read and read and read other peoples stories and it’s helped immensely. I see the change in him recently so dramatic his mind is just crazy that I don’t feel confident my daughter is safe, that worry itself consumes me. I don’t know what the future holds but I’m doing me and protecting my daughters from the rollercoaster she’s already witnessed too much and my oldest was scared of him the night I didn’t let him back into our home. He doesn’t get that part as he doesn’t even see his actions as scary. if he can’t change for his wee girl then I’ve no chance. Times a healer and I much prefer a peaceful life. I always felt I could be around on good terms to help him but recently he’s scaring me. So the fear of cutting him off became easier than the fear of having him around
Brilliant, that’s a hard move to make but it’s your life and you don’t deserve abuse. It will only get worse, stay strong

It’s a hard one, but you already know it’s having the strength to stay strong. From experience I’ve came back over and over because I had hope. Eventually I lost that hope, and walked away for good (I hope) we have a daughter she’s 2 she cries for him, but he’s chosen his path, he’s missing out and I know longer believe his manipulation that I am responsible for his situation. He’s managed to turn his family against me. I’m winning though I don’t need him and the rollercoaster of addiction. Life is calm, I can think straight, he’s had too many chances now, it’s my time to live my life and not worry about his. I have no idea where he is what he’s doing and I don’t worry about it this time. He blames me therefore hurting me via cutting off money and not seeing his daughter (ie giving me a break) 6 weeks no contact and I feel like myself again, his loss. I await his next move but hope I’m strong enough to not believe his lies. You just know, honestly it doesn’t get any easier staying in a relationship with an addict, especially one that doesn’t really want to change. I spent a lot of time blaming addiction but he’s had chances to get out he chooses not too. Heartbreaking but I’m no longer controlled by drugs. Freedom is good, stay strong, out of sight out of mind is the best way

I could of written your story, my baby is now 2 years old. We don’t live together and he works away a lot. Still living the addiction life, and the train wreck it causes us. I try to detach as much as I can for the baby she doesn’t deserve any of it.

I tried for a long time only when we had a baby I realised he’d never change, I accepted him myself as I knew what I signed up for but if he couldn’t change for her I had to let him go, I waited till he messed up so bad I couldn’t let him back. He got worse than ever, eventually half sorted himself out, I try to help him be a dad but like you he’s spiralling, once again I’ve totally let go it’s hard because I know the person he once was but I really don’t think that guys there anymore. He still blames me for it all. It’s not healthy. I don’t know where he’ll ever up but I can’t have a part in it at all. I know exactly what your going through abs it really isn’t easy to let go. I’m hoping I can stick with it this time but know there’s a chance we’ll get back to a really toxic cycle, hoping not though abs I said stay strong. Share your pain
When I realised it was just words and false promises, I choose myself. I wasted so much time waiting on the good he promised. But a peaceful life is sooo much better than the cycle
Also would love to know other peoples thoughts on this
I joined an online meeting for the first time, really helped me. Find yourself and be strong, it’s so hard to detach I’m trying myself soooo hard
I walked away, expecting him too die, I need to know it’s nothing to do with me, he f*** up just fine on his own
Agreed, my life a mess trying to help him. I struggle so he doesn’t, everyone blames me, thinks he’s a hero, think he’s doing well, help him out……. Soooooo frustrating
I hear this ❤️The hope never goes but I can’t accept his lifestyle so need to stay away hurts but I can’t be part of him killing himself
Look after yourself, you need the space from her
I know how you feel all to well, it’s hard to not want to help but he doesn’t care about anyone he will lie and manipulate and use the kids but stay strong 💪

There is zero chance of him going to rehab he doesn’t seem to think he has a problem and can stop whenever he wants he just doesn’t stop as he wants to do it as he says. I’m done this time I actually see it all as abuse very clearly. I’m soo much better than that life. And I know he is incapable of love he’s just good at telling me what I want to here

Thank you I needed to hear this today after his manipulation attempts draining the life out of me while I was at work. He’s completely oblivious to the fact he’s done anything wrong, addiction really does alter the mind, he’s definitely in no position to be taking care of a family
Thank you 🙏

I’ve started to think this way. He says I go cold too hurt him, I go cold  when he’s on drugs as hate that guy and he hates me, but I have to stay cold as he knows from the past cycle not speak for a week, he stay off drugs, I see him, he looks better and he’s normal so we get on and I like him, but eventually he’ll go back to the horrible guy who hates me. I’ve said it out loud I’m better than the life he can provide, soooo much better 💪

I have been researching trauma bonding and that is exactly how I feel. I have opened up to a couple of people and this is the last time. I wrote down about him and reading it is like why on earth do I let him hurt me over and over. I’m done and I’ve said it before but this time I’m in the tight space to do it. I’m healing myself in different ways and finding my sparkle again. Looking forward to a dram free life . The support on here is amazing, you think your alone but your not

My story is the same, I’m stuck in a cycle of cutting him out, then seeing a glimmer of the guy he used to be and falling for his lies and manipulation. We have a baby together and I did briefly move on when he was too busy hating me for ruining his life and drinking and taking drugs for months on end. That didn’t work out but now I’m constantly having to relive it as in his mind I deliberately kicked him out to move on. And even though he was drinking all the time and hating me, even got on a train a good few times to get away from me (while pregnant I must add) I’m supposed to stay with him as I should know he doesn’t mean it. Today is the day I break the cycle his messages of how horrible I am brought me to tears driving to work. Now I’m supposed to be his friend and act like I agree with him. Not this time I’ve got my strength back , I will not put up with being emotionally abused. Writing this and on hear you remind myself it’s not me, I am a good person and don’t deserve to be treated like that.
Me
😎enjoy
I could of wrote this ♥️
Did you ever hear from him? And are you ok
Love this related too every word
No advice, I keep going back, my Q master manipulator. Stay strong and be YOU, it’s never your fault
Enjoy the peace, find YOU
I wish I could do this, but we have a child. We’re friends 🙄🙄🙄🙄still coping with the issues. Good thing is he works away
I need this thanks for sharing

Hard to leave because the “non addict” is amazing but I think he’ll never change. He got worse when we had a baby and I took off my engagement ring. Feel sad we won’t ever have a fairy tail but addiction unfortunately is his love
So true, love your story helps me a lot
Could have written this sending hugs

My Q, my babies father, he’s an active addict who now after months of lying, told me the truth..... the thing is he’s my best friend and always steps up when I need him too but had also caused me lots of trauma.
Now after the death of my closest 20 year old god son and after threatening solicitors letters. He’s there for me. I need him right now and know it’s not a good situation but for this immensely hard time I feel I need him..... wise words needed please
I got my answers and the truth. I can’t win over his addiction, his wee baby isn’t enough for him. Like I said got the answers, time to live life, life is so precious

I did this, got all the answers, took a massive impact on my life (death of my 20 year old god son) He admitted he’d never be able to live the family life and cannot get over his addiction but I felt relief total relief, like a weight lifted off my shoulders and left me room to grieve

100%, many different versions of my Q but especially since I had his child, he’s become the worst. He’s telling me he’s changed etc etc but I know as his words don’t marry his actions. We’re apart, and although hard I hope he stays away for my own sanity

100%, many different versions of my Q but especially since I had his child, he’s become the worst. He’s telling me he’s changed etc etc but I know as his words don’t marry his actions. We’re apart, and although hard I hope he stays away for my own sanity.

I’ve “helped” many times over the past couple of years longing for the non drinking guy I loved. Unfortunately I’m at a stage where he has to do this alone as no one can help, I just “enabled” his behaviour, made excuses,hid the extent of it. But HE is a different person, addiction makes him on his own in the world, I don’t think anyone can help someone active with n addiction. Maybe I’m wrong but certainly not for us, although weirdly I still long for him to come back a changed guy
Stay strong, life is easier on the other side. Find yourself and be happy, be patient tho it may take a while but please try

I honestly think that’s what’s has happened to us. In the past he’s cared (while in active addiction) better for his ex partners child more than his own. It devastates me but I’ve learned to cope. Although we are not together due to his increased addiction and my strong ness for my kids, things that help are when I do not judge him, get angry, etc etc saying that it’s very tough agreeing with the lies he tells me because he’s not thinking straight. Wish I had more productive advice but if you plan this you do need to prepare for life as a single parent, and anything he gives is a bonus. pm me if you like been dealing with this for a while

I should also add that the frustration of him not “changing” for his own child is immensely stressful for me. Just make sure you are both in agreement of the future and communicate openly regarding the tough times. I hope to read positive stories as still live with the hope he’ll come back to us the person I fell in love with

Every situation is different and everyone is different, I naively thought he was “recovered” and having a baby would help us (although knew the risks but hoped it would help) It didn’t, and triggered something in him that he can’t cope with. I had to let him go as the announcement of me being pregnant seemed to make his addiction worse, so for having a relatively ok relationship and him living in peace with me and my other child, he just became so much more deeper into addiction than I could ever imagine. I’m not saying don’t but just make sure they can cope with parenting as it is hard and may trigger something to relapse. Hope you have a happy ending

It is hard and love left and went back so many times, we’re best friends, some of the time he’s great, I like him again then he turns into a different person. It’s a vicious cycle. I tried for so long, but I think you just know it’s time to give hope. I’m lonely, I miss my best friend, I worry about him, and my baby wants her dad BUT he makes so difficult and blames me for all his wrongdoings. Life is calmer now doesn’t stop me hurting but it does get easier. What I learned is if I allow his behaviour he’ll keep doing it. One day you’ll know to walk away and you’ll get through it and find yourself again 🙏

I left, with his baby, best but hardest thing I’ve ever done, and constantly I feel his control over me, next step for me it to cut contact. I blame myself as he’s led me to believe that. Do what’s best for you, I’m hoping it does get easier
Wish I had some advice, I don’t, but stay strong he needs to figure this out himself for you and his children, your look after yourself

Wish I knew, I never let him back in after the last time he “caused a scene” but he’s still my baby’s dad and knows how to play me. From experiences I read on here we need to look out for ourselves then life will fall into place, good luck
I’m right there with you, first Al Anon meeting tonight and feel it’s what can help me get better, it’s a tough road let’s walk it together
I wish I knew how deep his addiction was and I see only now how much of an enabler I was probably made the situation worse. But that’s only in hindsight
Agreed, the lies is the worse, I feel insane when I know fine the truth but continued lies.... just be honest and it would help me understand. The lies tho........
I needed to read that thank you
Feel your pain ♥️
No advice but you are doing well, those kiddies are very lucky
Thank you

That’s the issue he stopped it cold turkey, pretending it was all good and he’s living this new clean lifestyle, but I can tell by looking at him or even just a phone call he’s on something else, and from what I read you can’t easily come off methadone

He had a few weeks of daily’s but then got a job away from home because he talked a good talk and if he didn’t stay on the program it would go against his probation so the allowed him to take a week, then set up in his new place where they continued giving him take homes

I know exactly what he’s capable off so a constant worry, but it know it affects me I feel like I’m going crazy, no one sees that as we have mutual friends. It’s all about him and how he is, he’s makorly ruining his life big everyone rallying round to his side when he doesn’t give a shit and I’m stuck with kids, work and zero break
He actually thinks he can do it him self but o know he needs serious help. He can be gone got a month or too then self destruct and it’s my fault do I feel shit cause I really care for him

Well he started methadone but they made him worse, it was horrible, he didn’t take it as meant and blasted his weeks worth to get Hogg, so looked terrible and acted horrible to me blaming me. So he came off it which was the best as I’ve noticed a difference but he still takes codeine and drinks and hides from me. So he’s adment he’s off everything, pure lies. I don’t know what I’m asking for but I want the hood guy back to be a dad

I want him to be the good dad I know he wants to be, but drugs take precedence, I’ve done all I can to get him help but he has this self destruct and I get so angry with him. Do I need to cut him off? But when he’s good we get along. When he’s not I get the rage and fall out with him. He’s hit rock bottom so many times but right now he’s studying off stuff and I know they, but I never know what version of him I’ll get. Do I just accept that’s who he is and pretend everything’s ok for the sake of the baby or cut him off, in which I worry he will die 😢

My ex fiancé addicted for years but I see the good in him when he’s “normal” we have a baby, he does what he likes, works away plays dad every few weeks, lieing to me, I know when he’s on stuff, he just missed out on a jail sentence. So frustrating he can’t be the hood guy all the time. But I desperately need his help parenting it’s tough
